Bash(PYTHONPATH="D:/tempo/TempoSample/Plugins/Tempo/TempoCore/Content/Python/API/tempo" D:/tempo/TempoSample/TempoEnv/Scripts/python.exe -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert\(0, ''.''\)
from mcp.services.agentbridge import connect
client = connect\(''localhost'', 10001\)

# Search for stat command directly
print\(''=== Searching for ""stat"" as a standalone command ===''\)
result = client.search_console_commands\(''stat'', limit=50\)
# Filter to only show commands \(not CVars\) that are exactly ''stat'' or start with ''stat ''
for cmd in result.commands:
    if not cmd.is_variable and cmd.name.lower\(\).startswith\(''stat''\):
        print\(f''  {cmd.name}''\)
        if cmd.help:
            print\(f''    Help: {cmd.help[:80]}...''\)
")

import sys; sys.path.insert\(0, ''.''\)

print\(''=== OVERVIEW \(checking for COMPONENT NAMES section\) ===''\)
if ''COMPONENT NAMES'' in result[''help'']:
    print\(''FOUND component naming warning in overview''\)

    print\(''ERROR: Missing component naming in overview''\)

# Test properties topic
result = _get_help_text\(''properties''\)
print\(''\\n=== PROPERTIES TOPIC ===''\)
if ''INSTANCE names'' in result[''help''] and ''LightComponent0'' in result[''help'']:
    print\(''FOUND component naming guidance''\)
if ''tempo_set_color_property'' in result[''help'']:
    print\(''FOUND typed tools recommendation''\)

# Test workflows topic
result = _get_help_text\(''workflows''\)
print\(''\\n=== WORKFLOWS TOPIC ===''\)
if ''tempo_get_components'' in result[''help'']:
    print\(''FOUND light color workflow''\)
")
